over-sharded.description: Index has 10 primary shards for only ~500 documents. Each shard holds ~50 docs, well below the recommended minimum of 10-50GB per shard.

problems.evidence: 10 primary shards for ~500 documents (~50 docs per shard)
problems.impact: Each shard has fixed memory overhead (~10MB). 10 shards waste ~90MB of overhead for data that fits in one shard. Search must fan out to all 10 shards adding latency. Cluster state bloat.
problems.threshold: Recommended: 10-50GB per shard. This index is ~50KB total.

fix.alternative: Reindex into a new 1-shard index if shrink prerequisites aren't met
